bodyMarkdown:
## How to Convert Your Hourly Rate to Annual Salary in Australia

Understanding your annual salary from an hourly rate is straightforward: multiply your hourly pay by the hours you work each week, then multiply by 52 weeks. This guide explains the formula, the assumptions we make, and how tax and super affect your take-home pay. We also cover the National Minimum Wage, award rates, casual loading, and how a **salary sacrifice calculator australia** can help you plan your pay package.

### The Basic Formula

Annual gross pay = hourly rate × hours per week × 52

We assume a standard full-time week of 38 hours, as set by the Fair Work Ombudsman. If you work different hours, adjust the weekly figure accordingly. For example:

- $26.44 per hour (National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026) × 38 hours × 52 weeks = $52,269.44 per year
- $30 per hour × 38 hours × 52 weeks = $59,280 per year

Your fortnightly pay is simply your weekly pay multiplied by two. For the $30/hour example, weekly pay is $1,140, so fortnightly pay is $2,280 before tax.

### Understanding Minimum Wage and Award Rates

The Fair Work Commission sets the National Minimum Wage, which from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour for adults. This equates to $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. Many employees are covered by awards that set higher minimum rates for specific industries or roles. Award rates often include penalty rates for weekends, evenings, or overtime, but our calculator does not include those – it assumes the same rate every hour.

Casual employees receive a 25% loading on top of the base hourly rate to compensate for lack of paid leave. On our timesheet page, you can check a box to add 25% casual loading. Do not type a rate that already includes casual loading; the calculator adds it for you. For the minimum wage, casual loading brings the rate to $33.05 per hour.

### Superannuation: Paid on Top

Superannuation guarantee contributions are paid by your employer on top of your ordinary earnings. From 1 July 2026, the rate is 12% of your gross pay, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. This means if your annual salary is $60,000, your employer contributes an additional $7,200 to your super fund. The annual figure shown in our calculator does not include super – it is your salary before super is added.

### Tax and Medicare Levy

For the 2026–27 financial year, the Australian Taxation Office resident tax rates are:

- $0 – $18,200: nil
- $18,201 – $45,000: 15% on excess over $18,200
- $45,001 – $135,000: 30% on excess over $45,000
- $135,001 – $190,000: 37% on excess over $135,000
- $190,001 and above: 45% on excess over $190,000

Medicare levy is generally 2% of your taxable income. The calculator uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds for Medicare because the 2026–27 thresholds were not confirmed in this estimate. It does not deduct HELP loans, the Medicare levy surcharge, or salary packaging.

### Using a Salary Sacrifice Calculator Australia

A **salary sacrifice calculator australia** helps you see how pre-tax deductions for things like super contributions, cars, or laptops affect your take-home pay. While our hourly-to-annual tool does not include salary sacrifice, you can use the annual gross figure as a starting point. For example, if you salary sacrifice $5,000 into super, your taxable income reduces, potentially lowering your tax bracket. Always check with your employer or the Australian Taxation Office for specific arrangements.

### Fortnightly Pay and Budgeting

Many Australian employees are paid fortnightly. To find your fortnightly gross pay, multiply your weekly pay by two. For a $30/hour rate working 38 hours, weekly pay is $1,140, so fortnightly gross is $2,280. After tax and Medicare, your take-home pay will be less. Use our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) guide to estimate net amounts.

### Important Notes and Limitations

Our calculator provides an estimate only. It assumes:

- The same hourly rate every week (no overtime, penalty rates, or allowances)
- A 38-hour week unless you change the hours
- No unpaid overtime
- No salary sacrifice or packaging
- Super at 12% of ordinary earnings, capped at $270,830
- Tax using the 2026–27 resident scale with full tax-free threshold
- Medicare using 2025–26 single reduction thresholds

For a more precise calculation, refer to your pay slip, award, or enterprise agreement. You can also explore our [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) page for current rates, or [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) for details on contributions and salary sacrifice.

### Industry and State Averages

The Australian Bureau of Statistics publishes Average Weekly Earnings. For May 2026, full-time adult ordinary time earnings were $2,083.70 per week. All employees total earnings (including part-time) averaged $1,579.20 per week. These are averages, not medians for your specific job. Use our [average pay](/topics/average-pay) page for more context.

### Final Thoughts

Converting your hourly rate to an annual salary helps you compare job offers, budget, and plan for tax. Remember that super is extra, and your take-home pay depends on tax brackets and any salary sacrifice arrangements. A **salary sacrifice calculator australia** can further refine your planning. Always consult official sources like the Fair Work Ombudsman, Australian Taxation Office, and your employer for personalised advice.
